answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the quartz of a task receipt, and the quill is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the violet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
